header: THE PROVIDENT FUND PAGE: one page, two tabs: "PF maturity" (the probable PF on the retirement day, PfForm) and "PF loan EMI" (the refundable PF loan, PfLoanForm). I keep both tabs in memory while the page is open, so what was typed in one is still there when the other has been looked at.

symbols.name: TABS
symbols.sig: const TABS: Array<{ id: PfTab; label: string }> = [{ id: "maturity", label: "PF maturity" }, { id: "loan", label: "PF loan EMI" }]

symbols.name: startTabFor
doc: A line typed in the search bar that is about the loan (emi, loan, instalment, repayment) opens the page on the loan tab; anything else opens the maturity tab.

symbols.name: PfPage
symbols.sig: export function PfPage({ start = "maturity", today }: { start?: PfTab; today?: YMD })

behaviours: the page has two tabs, PF maturity then PF loan EMI
it opens on PF maturity, or on PF loan EMI when asked to
the tabs are linked to their panels (tab controls a tabpanel that is labelled by it), and only the open one is shown: the other has the hidden attribute
the maturity tab is the same PF maturity form as before (the three parts, the PF page figures), and the loan tab is the loan form
a line about the loan opens the loan tab: emi, loan, instalment, repayment; any other line, and the list of calculators, the maturity tab
the list of calculators has ONE provident fund tile (it had two: PF maturity and Loan EMI) and no Loan EMI tile, and the old loan calculator is not a topic any more
the tile names both: PF on the retirement day, and the EMI of a refundable PF loan
the page keeps the wide box of the PF form
opened from 'pf loan emi' the form starts on the loan tab; from the list (no line about a loan) on maturity
the loan form asks for the loan amount, the interest the PF deposit earns (8.25), the date of retirement (DD/MM/YYYY) and the period (years or months)
the loan's own rate is shown, worked from the deposit's: 9.25% a year = 8.25% + 1%; it is not a box to type in
the period says its limit: 10 years until a retirement date is given
nothing is calculated until the figures are in, and it says what is needed
it states the three rules (deposit + 1%, at most 10 years and the service left, the balance still owed month by month)
it says a non-refundable (NRL) loan has no instalment and shows on the PF page as 'Less N.R.Loan', and that the amount one may borrow is not checked
nothing of the bank, car, home or society loans is left: no 'Bank loan', no 'Co-operative', no flat-rate choice, no kind-of-loan list
what is typed is not saved or sent: the form has no fetch, storage or network call
the table has two views, Year-wise and Month-wise, switched by two buttons; it opens on the year-wise one
year-wise: one row for each year (5), with the total paid, the principal, the interest and the balance at the year's end
month-wise: one row for EVERY month from the first to the last (60), with that month's EMI, its principal, its interest and the balance after it
month-wise: in every row the EMI is the principal plus the interest of that month (to the rupee), and the first row's interest is a month of 9.25% on the whole 5 lakh
month-wise: the instalment is the same in every month but the last (a rounding of paise at most), the interest falls and the principal rises as the balance falls, and the balance ends at ₹ 0
both views are of the same loan: the principal of the year rows and of the month rows each add up to 5 lakh, and so do the interest rows
every row is shown, none behind a 'Show ... rows' button; the month-wise view scrolls inside its box with its header kept in sight
